name: security-open-redirect
title: Security — the inbox deep-link route redirects wherever it is told

pullRequest.title: Land support inbox deep links on the console
pullRequest.body:
Links in the support inbox point at console pages, but agents who are signed out get bounced to the home page and lose the link.

Adds GET /open?to=<path>, which the inbox links through: it checks the session and then sends the agent on to the page the link names.
pullRequest.author: tom-veldhuis
